verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly support non-interactive automation: piping logs into it, running it in CI, chaining with other tools (claude-code-docs-7), scheduling recurring runs like PR reviews and CI failure analysis (claude-code-docs-8), and using GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/CD for automated code review and issue triage (claude-code-docs-36). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of non-interactive flag usage (e.g., -p/print mode) in real scripted pipelines, and no community verification of headless CI reliability.
